assessments.summary: The audited verifier establishes the stated SHA-256 digest, decoding to a 152-point no-three-in-line subset of G_76, quarter-turn invariance, a two-image dihedral orbit, and exactly eight distinct translated embeddings in G_77. Exhaustive blocking and deletion analyses establish the claimed minimum blocking multiplicity, singleton- and pair-deletion behavior, exactly 16 freeing pairs per embedding, and the resulting bounds |E\S|≥3, |S\E|≥4, and |E△S|≥7 for any no-three-in-line S of size at least 153.
scopeQualifications: The conclusions apply separately to the eight verified embeddings only.
The claim does not concern arbitrary record configurations and does not establish the global value of D(77).
